title: Functions: Inputs and Outputs
seo_title: Grade 8 Functions Worksheets: Is It a Function, Vertical Line Test, Linear or Nonlinear
standard_text: Understand that a function is a rule that assigns to each input exactly one output. The graph of a function is the set of ordered pairs consisting of an input and the corresponding output.
meta_desc: Free Grade 8 functions worksheets: decide if a relation is a function from pairs, tables and graphs, use the vertical line test, evaluate f(x), tell linear from nonlinear, and compare functions. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: A function gives each input exactly one output.
key_sub: Outputs may repeat. If a vertical line crosses the graph twice, it is not a function.
body_html:
What is a function?

A function is a rule that gives each input exactly one output. Outputs can repeat, but an input cannot have two different outputs.

RelationFunction?Why
(1, 3), (2, 3), (3, 3)Yeseach input has one output
(2, 1), (2, 5), (3, 6)Noinput 2 has two outputs

The vertical line test

If any vertical line crosses a graph more than once, the graph is not a function.

Example

If f(x) = 3x − 2, find f(4).

Replace x with 4: 3 × 4 − 2.

12 − 2 = 10.

Answer: f(4) = 10

Linear or nonlinear?

A linear function has a constant rate of change and a straight-line graph: y = mx + b. If x is squared, cubed, in an exponent or in the bottom of a fraction, the function is nonlinear.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking repeated outputs break a function. Only repeated inputs with different outputs do.
  • Using a horizontal line for the test. Use a vertical line.
  • Thinking every curve is not a function. y = x² is a function.

faq.q: How do you know if a relation is a function?
faq.a: Check the inputs. If any input has two different outputs, it is not a function. Outputs may repeat.

faq.q: What is the vertical line test?
faq.a: Draw vertical lines through the graph. If any of them crosses the graph more than once, the graph is not a function.
f(x) is the output of the function f for the input x. f(4) means put 4 in for x.

faq.q: How do you tell if a function is linear?
faq.a: A linear function changes by the same amount each step and its graph is a straight line. It can be written as y = mx + b.

sets.title: Graphs and the vertical line test

items.q: What is the vertical line test?
c: If any vertical line crosses a graph more than once, it is not a function
If a horizontal line crosses twice, it is not a function
Every graph with a curve is not a function
A function must be a straight line
items.e: A vertical line is one input x. Crossing twice means two outputs. If any vertical line crosses a graph more than once, it is not a function.

items.e: Use the vertical line test. Any vertical line crosses this line once. Yes.

items.e: Go to x = 3, then up or down to the line: y = 5.

items.q: Function A: y = 3x + 2. Function B: the table (0, 1), (1, 5), (2, 9). Which has the greater rate of change?
items.e: A: rate 3, start 2. B: rate 4, start 1. The answer is B.

items.q: A function starts at 12 and goes down 2 each step. Which equation is it?
items.e: Rate −2, initial value 12: y = −2x + 12.

items.q: Function A: y = 2x + 5. Function B: a line through (0, 3) and (2, 9). Which has the greater initial value?
items.e: A: rate 2, start 5. B: rate 3, start 3. The answer is A.

items.q: A gym charges y = 25x + 50. What does 50 mean?
items.e: The initial value is the cost at x = 0 months: a one-time fee of $50.

items.e: A: rate 12, start 4. B: rate 1, start 4. The answer is B.

items.q: A gym charges y = 25x + 50. What does 25 mean?
items.e: The rate of change is the cost for each month: $25 each month.

items.q: Function A: y = 4x + 1. Function B goes through (0, 1) and (1, 5). How do they compare?
items.e: B has slope (5 − 1) ÷ 1 = 4 and starts at 1: they are the same function.

items.q: Function A: y = 2x − 3. Function B: a line through (0, −1) and (3, 5). Which has the greater initial value?
items.e: A: rate 2, start −3. B: rate 2, start −1. The answer is B.

items.q: Function A: y = 3x. Function B: y = x². For x = 2, which is greater?
items.e: A: 3 × 2 = 6. B: 2² = 4. A is greater.

items.q: Taxi A: $3 plus $2 per mile. Taxi B: y = 2.5x + 1. Which has the higher cost per mile?
items.e: A: rate 2, start 3. B: rate 52, start 1. The answer is B.

items.q: Function A: y = 3x. Function B: y = x². For x = 5, which is greater?
items.e: A: 15. B: 25. B is greater. A nonlinear function can pass a linear one.

items.q: Plan A: $20 plus $5 a month. Plan B: the table (0, 35), (1, 38), (2, 41). Which has the higher starting cost?
items.e: A: rate 5, start 20. B: rate 3, start 35. The answer is B.

items.q: Line A has slope 2 and starts at 0. Line B has slope 2 and starts at 5. Which is true?
items.e: Same slope, different starts: they are parallel.

items.q: Car A: y = 55x. Car B: 120 miles in 2 hours. Which has the greater speed?
items.e: A: rate 55, start 0. B: rate 60, start 0. The answer is B.

items.q: Tank A: y = −4x + 50. Tank B: starts at 60 gallons, loses 3 gallons a minute. Which has the faster draining?
items.e: A: rate −4, start 50. B: rate −3, start 60. The answer is A.
